mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 72 degrees with slight rain near Badger Ridge Middle School and a Waning Crescent moon visible.
The Verona Fire Department is inviting everyone to an open house on September 19 from 10 am to 2 pm at 101 Lincoln Street, featuring tours, fire safety activities, and food.

Today is packed with activities including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, pizza at Lake Lou-ee, and trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory, with more trivia coming up tomorrow at Hop Haus.
The Verona Police Department announced the arrest of 34-year-old Halla Nelson on Friday, September 4, following a report received on Sunday, August 30, regarding an incident from 2019.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough, and the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
